title: [spec-gap][R-11-006] RTOS IPC transport lci_send/lci_recv absent from all stacks (spec 17.3.4)
description: Spec 17.3.4: same-device RTOS applications send/receive discrete IPv6 packets via void lci_send(const uint8_t*, size_t) and size_t lci_recv(uint8_t*, size_t, uint32_t timeout_ms); no framing needed. Classification: not-implemented (repo-wide: the only occurrences are the spec lines 143/146). Closest existing: ble_lci_send netif (lichen/apps/gateway/src/ble_lci_netif.c:76), KISS ports KISS_PORT_LCI_IPV6=2 / KISS_PORT_LCI_CTRL=3 (lichen/subsys/lichen/transport/kiss_transport.h:84-85); transport Kconfig lists only 17.3.1/17.3.2 bindings. Suggested placement: Zephyr lichen/subsys/lichen/transport IPC transport (message queue or pipe backed) + Kconfig entry citing 17.3.4; Rust/Python sim equivalents optional.
